* Microsoft Copilot: An AI-powered assistant embedded across Microsoft 365 apps (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams) and Windows to draft content, summarize meetings, and analyze data. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWgHrOzAVhimdPZNcHXJRkYjIwI6IbygJm7Nh3E8ey73zLONmX2E69rF_5N0xCtt6i2OxX8_5xOBXyob7FoXj7vBJVqkYScQeDrtiipEDeGVHiyIqJL8FCoiiSQ)]
* Microsoft Fabric: A unified data and intelligence platform connecting analytics and AI workloads. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWgHrOzAVhimdPZNcHXJRkYjIwI6IbygJm7Nh3E8ey73zLONmX2E69rF_5N0xCtt6i2OxX8_5xOBXyob7FoXj7vBJVqkYScQeDrtiipEDeGVHiyIqJL8FCoiiSQ)]
* Homegrown MAI Models: Microsoft has increasingly developed its own internal AI models (such as audio and multimodal tech) alongside its partnership with OpenAI. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESxQEB6zswFdAn0PXCR3SMOTU2ViQaEW1HjbwXNfAMG74vsPArG6uygxnwpCdMmzpUgaSakEyGxUG6ICHmqYPf5voQpt_1qcNbKiWU2GNFEN-5qjccYGYrHpL7YNuW8sE_EIENT_wA60eu4QkJXOMO-BHPhAY1C4V4OalxYiAQiXulOVnPI1BvJiHD8fkhSm188oQmGnBKpmsc2thLmvlxkAmFbyLeQjmAakY9kTbzmoqpOf2O5rVhI2Pw360uHUkOWEzHP9kwZw)]

Workplace Transformation & Workforce Impact

* Workflow Redesign: Microsoft emphasizes redesigning end-to-end business processes and deploying specialized AI agents rather than just dropping tools into old routines. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESnAEB6zswFZv0FotJS-ZV8dhsZOjzoz4a4zfHY33Hvy8f7jfdCHAZKKL4pz7grSEHFJKhjw1ClzJZqpCZv2oSSbwRJZY9NivWsaUgb6THWMQQmM69Cx3Rooru-BALQw05cnoUdH99LESo6jd1k0Kjw9Pz5hRQwcbIs8U3e0xYeyXIcxHcTWsRwC1IcDWKAkSH3zLgNh4lHgz3cWl-vZE)]
